reviews.comment: Dr. Wicksten does not actually teach anything in her seminar class. All presentations are given by students taking the class and your grade is determined by your peers. Dr. Wicksten is very bad with technology and makes it everyone else's problem. It was a very easy class, but I wish I had actually learned something from the professor.

I took Dr. Wicksten for marine biology and I swear I have never taken a more interesting class. All of her practice exams ended up being the exam she was going to give on the real exam day, gave extra credit to redeem for her mistake on exam 2, and let me do more extra credit to bump my grade to an A! She also tells the most interesting stories

She is older so she's note the best at posting grades or notes, take your own. The best way to study for this class is to memorize lab slides then make comparative tables between common groups and large cladograms per exam then will in the information for each group. If you ask for help she'll help you answer the extra credit points ~25.

481 is a seminar class, meaning your grade is based on one 10 minute presentation given to the class. Class participation is rating other's presentations, although attendance is not mandatory and not graded. No rubric for the presentation but there are guidelines in the syllabus. Professor is very accessible via email.

Honestly... All you have to do is show up and listen then really review the questions on previous exams (which she gives you). The field trip was one of the most fun experiences I've had while at A&M. Shes super fun but her lectures meander a lot. I would recommend just listening in class and jotting down only the important points.

I had Dr. Wicksten for 440 and 335; while the material can be tough, she gives you all you need for exams. She's very experienced and has lots of stories which made lectures interesting for me and stays after class if you have questions. You have to work for your grade, but you learn a lot, especially if you're interested in the field.

Don't take this class unless you have to. She sometimes offered extra credit, but that was to pass kids. It is almost impossible to make an A, but possible to make a B. There was so much material, and she never answers emails. Exams are closed note, and always pressed for time. She won't curve, and the cut off is a 90. Lectures didn't really help..

Do not take if you don't have to. The tests were extremely difficult. These were some of the hardest test I have ever taken. (free response 80 questions in 60 minutes). She didn't answer emails, she offered extra credit to anyone below 70.. but not above. The lab was easy and carried me in grades. She was sweet, but the class was too difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was a disaster, especially online. Every lecture was a battle for her to operate zoom and powerpoint even by the end of the semester. The tests are very difficult, require very specific answers to be right, and take every minute given to complete. Take a different class if you can.
